end.summary:
Top, front and side views were understood for the practiced solids and on a new-situation question.
Explaining why views change from different places was practised; this still needs checking next time.
Matching views to objects was practised; this still needs checking next time.
The handle-view mix-up was corrected after further questioning; the same-view-from-every-side and drawing-known-details mix-ups remained.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised describing and matching top, front and side views of spheres, cones and cylinders. Using questions about a cup handle helped them correct the idea that another person sees the same view; the idea that an object looks the same from every side still needs revisiting. At home, place a cup or toy on a table and ask Reyansh to draw what is visible from two different places, without adding hidden parts.
